blindRule: Generation reasoning uses only V6 PRD + current Figma/manifest/pattern/design-system evidence. Stitch artifacts are excluded until post-generation comparison.

references.use: Keep A-40 visibly in the participant My Page/results lineage rather than treating it as a public campaign landing page.
Reuse announcement hierarchy only: result first, supporting explanation second, next action last. Do not copy campaign skin literally.
Translate evaluation evidence into participant-readable summaries; exclude admin/reviewer controls.
Buttons and tags are instances; use validated variants and variant-scoped patch node names.

userQuestionOrder: 더 자세히 보거나 제출 원본을 어디서 확인하나?
compositionReasoning.densityStrategy: Keep the hero emotionally clear but compact; spend vertical space on readable evaluation evidence rather than decorative campaign content.
compositionReasoning.stateStrategy: AWARDED_RANK is the blind-v2 generation sample. AWARDED_SPECIAL and NOT_AWARDED should later be derived by state-specific hero/tag treatment without changing information architecture.

regions.purpose: Anchor the screen in My Page / my application result flow.
Answer result and score in one glance.
regions.layout: horizontal split: award/result message left, score panel right

regions.purpose: Show why the result happened, separated by AI and human evaluation source.
contents: AI review: source scope + summary comment + score
Human review: concise judge comment + score
constraints: do not invent item names or detailed rubric

regions.purpose: Continue to detailed review or final submission viewer.

mustPass: Stitch content has not been consulted
all componentNodeId values exist in current catalog
all patch nodeName values are validated against the selected variant scope
all token bindings already exist in the current design system
no PRD-unknown business facts are introduced
